sections.h2: Where is Englewood, Colorado, and how big is it?
sections.html:
Englewood is a small city in western Arapahoe County, immediately south of Denver in the South Platte River valley. It covers about 6.6 square miles at an elevation of 5,348 feet.

The 2020 census counted 33,659 residents, up from 30,255 in 2010, and the Census Bureau estimated 35,305 for July 1, 2025. Density was 5,127 people per square mile in 2020, the highest of the four Colorado cities in the Census table we used.

Households here are small, and just under half of homes are owner-occupied, so Englewood sellers include many owners of small houses and condos as well as landlords.

Gold was found near the mouth of what became Little Dry Creek in 1858, and Thomas Skerritt built a home called Orchard Place in 1860. The town was incorporated on May 9, 1903, with J.C. Jones as its first mayor.

In 1948 the city bought 2,500 acres on the Platte Canyon, which led to McLellan Reservoir. City Park was sold in 1965 to make way for the Cinderella City mall, which opened in 1968. About 30 years later the city demolished the defunct mall and replaced it with a transit-oriented development around the light-rail stop.

sections.h2: What are the main areas of Englewood?
sections.html:
Englewood is divided by Broadway and Hampden Avenue into four quadrants, and each has a different housing mix.

  • Northwest: the oldest section, with downtown, City Center and housing from the 1910s. A former General Iron site is awaiting redevelopment.
  • Southwest: newer housing along with many industrial facilities, plus Belleview Park.
  • Southeast: almost entirely residential and newer than the north and southwest, reaching the Highline Canal.
  • Northeast: the hospital complex that includes Swedish Medical Center and Craig Hospital.

Hampden Hills is described as the newest and wealthiest part of the city, with many apartment complexes. Age of housing is a useful question for any seller. Houses dating to the 1910s may need electrical, plumbing and foundation work that a lender's appraiser will notice.

sections.h2: Who are the largest employers in Englewood?
sections.html:
Hospitals are the backbone of the Englewood economy. The 2023 top employer list on Wikipedia is led by Swedish Medical Center and Craig Hospital, followed by Groove Toyota, Metro Community Provider Network, Veolia Transportation, Rollinc Staffing, Walmart, Meadow Gold Dairies, Ouray Sportswear and American Bottling.

The Census Bureau's 2022 figures show health care and social assistance receipts of about $1.13 billion, and retail sales per capita of $46,983, the highest of the four cities compared. Englewood draws shoppers from beyond its own residents, and 75.1% of those aged 16 and over are in the civilian labor force.

For a seller, hospital and retail jobs mean steady local rental demand, but they do not help a house that needs a new roof or sewer line.

sections.h2: How do schools, transit and weather affect an Englewood house?
sections.html:
Englewood Public Schools serves most of the city, with small portions in Littleton Public Schools and Sheridan Public Schools. Part of Cherry Hills Village is also in the Englewood district.

The Englewood station on RTD's D Line sits in the Civic Center, and the line runs from Littleton to 18th and California in Denver. Mean travel time to work was 22.6 minutes in the 2020 to 2024 Census data.

The climate is cold semi-arid, drier than much of the Front Range at 10.42 inches of annual precipitation, with record readings of 108 degrees and minus 33. Wide temperature swings are tough on roofs and exterior finishes.

sections.h2: What are Arapahoe County's property tax dates for Englewood owners?
sections.html:
Arapahoe County bills Englewood property tax under the same state calendar as the rest of Colorado. Colorado statute 39-10-104.5 lets an owner pay in two halves, due on or before the last day of February and by June 15, or pay in one payment on or before the last day of April.

Interest on late amounts runs at 1% per month, and any part of a month counts as a whole month. Installments under $25 cannot be split and must be paid in full by April 30. The Justia copy we opened is the 2022 version, so confirm the current rule with the Arapahoe County Treasurer.

When an Englewood house sells, the title company prorates the current year's tax through the closing date. Unpaid taxes from earlier years must be cleared before the deed can transfer cleanly.

sections.h2: What are Englewood's short-term rental rules?
sections.html:
Englewood requires every short-term rental operator to hold both a city sales and use tax license and a short-term rental license. In residential zones the operator must be the primary resident and live at the property at least 185 days a year.

  • Applications need a current deed on file with Arapahoe County, a notarized residency affidavit and two proofs of primary residence in residential zones.
  • Insurance must include at least $1 million in personal liability coverage.
  • Parking must include one permanent space per rented bedroom, with no more than two on the street.
  • Fee amounts on the city page rose January 1, 2026: $600 for a new application and $400 for a renewal, plus $75 for inspection and $200 at issuance.

A house that cannot meet these conditions may be worth less to a buyer who planned to rent it nightly, so check the license status before pricing.

sections.h2: How do you sell an Englewood house fast?
sections.html:
You can list with an agent, sell on your own or take a cash purchase. A listing may bring the highest price on a house in good shape, while a cash sale is the faster path for a house that needs work, has tenants or sits in an estate.

Colorado's documentary fee on a deed is $0.01 per $100 of consideration over $500. We buy houses in Englewood and nearby Arapahoe County in any condition. Tell us about the property, and you will get an answer with no obligation if you say no.

faqs.q: What is the median home value in Englewood?
faqs.a: The Census Bureau's 2020 to 2024 median value of owner-occupied homes in Englewood is $572,900. Treat it as a benchmark, since each house differs.
Englewood is in Arapahoe County, where its deeds are recorded and its property taxes are billed.

faqs.q: Do I need a license for an Airbnb in Englewood?
faqs.a: Yes. You need a city sales and use tax license and a short-term rental license, and in residential zones you must live at the property at least 185 days a year.

faqs.q: When are Colorado property taxes due for an Englewood house?
faqs.a: State law allows two halves, due by the last day of February and by June 15, or a single payment by the last day of April.

faqs.q: Can I sell an Englewood house with an unfinished repair?
faqs.a: Yes. A cash buyer purchases the house as it stands, so unfinished work does not have to be completed before closing.
